channel.title: Stargazer · Notes
channel.description: A student who turns passing thoughts into things people can actually use — mini programs, small tools, and a bit of geography that moves.

item.title: How this site was built
item.description: A bilingual MIUI-X flavoured personal site in Astro, with a background Earth that moves as you scroll.

item.title: The river at night
item.description: A whole row of lights on the far bank. The reflection down the water was brighter than the street itself.
